#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    int countMax = 0;
    int countNoInside = 0;
    int currentWordLength = 0;
    bool inBrackets = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        
        if (ch == '(') {
            countMax = std::max(countMax, currentWordLength);
            currentWordLength = 0;
            inBrackets = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            if (currentWordLength > 0) {
                countNoInside++;
            }
            currentWordLength = 0;
            inBrackets = false;
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (inBrackets) {
                if (currentWordLength > 0) {
                    countNoInside++;
                }
            } else {
                countMax = std::max(countMax, currentWordLength);
            }
            currentWordLength = 0;
        } else {
            currentWordLength++;
        }
    }
    
    countMax = std::max(countMax, currentWordLength);
    std::cout << countMax << " " << countNoInside << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
